verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents a built-in agent platform. Users can create and manage AI agents, configure them in the web UI, and attach MCP servers to an individual agent independent of its model, which supports task-specific assistants. The evidence is brief one-liners and does not show how agents are specialized beyond tool attachment. Missing for 10: documented per-agent instructions or system prompts, detail on agent configuration options, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can create specialized custom assistants configured for specific tasks

citations.quote: Create and manage AI agents with MCP tool support
LocalAI comes with a **built-in web interface** for chatting with models, managing installations, configuring AI agents, and more
LocalAI's agents can also attach MCP servers to a single **agent**, independent of the model it runs on.
LocalAI includes a built-in AI agent platform with support for the [Model Context Protocol (MCP)]
